summary: Your drive and your need to break free grind against each other. You move in sudden bursts, chafe at any restriction, and provoke when you feel boxed in. The energy doesn't like to wait.
body: Your drive and your need to break free grind against each other. You move in sudden bursts, chafe at any restriction, and provoke when you feel boxed in. The energy doesn't like to wait. You may act out the second you feel controlled, or rebel against the very structure that would get you where you want to go. That friction is the engine you run on; it makes you brave and quick to act. The work is choosing your fights and putting a beat between the impulse and the move.
gift: At your best: brave, quick, unafraid to break a rule that needs breaking.
shadow: The trap: acting out the moment you feel controlled, rebelling against your own goals.
integration: Give your body a direct outlet and your choices a short pause. You do not need to become tame; you need enough timing to make your freedom effective.
do: Put a beat between impulse and move
Rebel against what actually deserves it
dont: Act out when you feel controlled
Tear down the structure you need
